verdict.rationale: Bento documents a `POST /batch/subscribers` endpoint that bulk creates or updates 1 to 1000 subscribers per request without triggering automations, and its events API can update profile fields. Custom fields are documented and can be set via the API, which covers create and update with custom properties in batches. Suppression is not directly evidenced: the only related items are an anonymization/deletion endpoint and filtering by unsubscribe dates, neither an explicit unsubscribe or suppress API. Missing for 10: an explicit API for suppressing or unsubscribing contacts, documented rate limits or throughput at production scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the bulk API.
